purpose: Turn the declared Qwen immutability boundary into an enforced fail-closed check, and register model and RAG data provenance, without claiming operational readiness the artifacts do not support.
requiredInvariants: The verifier must fail closed on any disagreement between the declared boundary and the model governance artifacts.
PINNED_WEIGHTS must be reported false while the bundle lifecycle is not finalized; it may never be rounded up to a pass.
No operational, benchmark, admission or production-readiness claim may be made for Qwen.
Qwen model weights, tokenizer, revision and configuration must not be modified, fine-tuned, LoRA-adapted or mutated.
Qwen must remain THIRD_PARTY_INFRASTRUCTURE and must never be presented as the rights holder's own model.
The data register must record terms honestly; unresolved reuse terms stay UNRESOLVED.
No product code, dependency, lockfile or production configuration may change.
Merge and CI success are not REG.RU production deployment evidence.
acceptance: The verifier exits non-zero on a swapped model, a mutated boundary invariant, a revision or model mismatch between artifacts, a withdrawn approval, a missing licence, a non-human review or an unpinned upstream hash.
Unit tests cover both the consistent case and every fail-closed case.
The verifier runs in CI against the real artifacts.
DATA_AND_MODEL_PROVENANCE.csv records the foundation model, the evaluated candidate and all six official RAG sources with owner, terms, hashes and status.
The concurrent-scope guard accepts exactly the five authorized paths.
